_doc: MCW bridge<->mod protocol v1. TCP 127.0.0.1:25600 (config/mcw.properties), UTF-8, one JSON object per line. Coordinates are Minecraft blocks (the bridge converts from Witcher). t = type. Every mc->bridge message carries tick. Block lists are flat: b/set [x,y,z,palIndex,...], clear [x,y,z,...]; pal is per message. Air and barrier are never listed (barrier = Witcher ground).

Connections: the one that sent hello is the bridge; a new hello evicts the previous bridge. Other connections (debug: cmd, ping, pos, act, give) are served in parallel. Replies (ack, dig, cmd_out, ground_ok, recipes, pong, error) go to the connection that asked; world events (chunk, unchunk, snap_end, blocks, inv, hp, ent, explosion, pteleport, death, respawn) go to the bridge only. snap is bridge-only.
Numbers from the bridge must be finite: pos/act with NaN, Infinity or a point outside the world -> error bad_args (pos) or ack why=bad_args (act). Numbers from the mod are finite or null.

_note: radius = min(want.radius, server view-distance): further chunks are never loaded around Geralt; ent = settings of the ent stream (config/mcw.properties ent_radius, ent_every, ent_max); player.client = Geralt is the hidden client's player (mcclient), not the puppet
chunk may come at any time, also after snap_end: a chunk loaded late or Geralt moved

the whole Inventory of 1.21.11 (43 slots), non-empty only: 0-8 hotbar, 9-35 backpack, 36-39 armor feet..head, 40 offhand, 41-42 body and saddle (empty for a player); sel = selected hotbar slot; dmg = [slot,damage,max] of damaged items. Comes in the same tick as any change: act, pickup, craft, /give
why: occupied, too_far, too_high, too_low, out_of_world, not_allowed, no_item, used_block, rejected, bad_args, bad_slot; unloaded right after a far pos is normal - repeat the act a bit later
place = vanilla right click: useItemOn, and if that passes - useItem (bucket, boat, pearl aim with yaw/pitch). sneak=true places onto a crafting table/chest instead of opening it

ok only if blocks or inventory changed or an item use started; a click the block consumed (here [5,70,-40] is a crafting table, the menu opened) is used_block; with sneak:true the block would be placed on top
use = right click into the air with the held item (eat, throw a pearl, bucket along the view ray)
select = hotbar slot 0..8, like the vanilla carried-item packet: switching stops an item use of the main hand; the new sel comes in inv of the same tick
server moved Geralt itself (/tp, pearl, portal). If dim changed: unchunk for every old chunk, then chunk... and snap_end of the new dimension follow

msg: Geralt was blown up by Creeper

_note: dim may differ from the death dimension (died in the Nether - respawn in the overworld): then unchunk/chunk/snap_end follow as after pteleport

Geralt changed hands: the hidden Minecraft client (mcclient) logged in under his name and took the puppet's place (client:true), or it left and the puppet is back (client:false). Same UUID, same playerdata. inv and hp follow in the same tick; the mirror follows the new player
sent instead of handling a message while Geralt is changing hands (a few ticks between the puppet leaving and the client joining). hello waits instead; ping and cmd are served
skip = columns [x,z,...] in unloaded chunks, nothing placed there: resend them after their chunk arrives. Own barrier positions are saved with the world (SavedData)
left = own barrier positions in unloaded chunks, kept for the next ground_clear
any=true (box required, at most 64x64 chunks): also any barrier in loaded chunks of the box, own or not

text: Gamerule minecraft:advance_time is now set to: false

_note: bridge only. Chunks outside the new radius come as unchunk first, then the full snapshot
ents = entities the bridge knows from the ent stream

_doc: Stages 3 (crafting) and 5 (mobs). recipes, craft and spawn are answered to the connection that asked; ent goes to the bridge only. Minecraft decides: recipes come from the server RecipeManager, crafting goes through the vanilla menus (2x2 InventoryMenu, 3x3 CraftingMenu of a crafting table in reach), mobs run vanilla AI.

_note: r = [recipe id, result item, count per craft, max crafts in a row from the inventory, grid 2|3]; grid 3 is listed also without a table (craft then says no_table); table = nearest crafting table in reach or null; sorted by item, then recipe
n crafts in a row (1..256) while ingredients last
made = items produced, crafts = how many times; ok if at least one craft; why explains a stop before n; inv with the new contents follows in the same tick
why: bad_recipe, impossible (special recipe without a layout), no_table (3x3 and no crafting table in reach), missing (not enough ingredients), inv_full, rejected (doLimitedCrafting, disabled item)
Geralt's Minecraft horse (Steve mode, key X): tamed, saddled, fast; one per world (tag mcw_horse), an existing one within 256 blocks comes again. Placed 3 blocks behind Geralt
reply to horse (to the sender)
test helper: a mob of type d blocks in front of Geralt (his yaw), on the first support from +3 down to -8 blocks; like /summon (finalizeSpawn, vanilla AI)
ent = entity id in the ent stream; why: bad_type, bad_args (d not in 0..32), no_ground, rejected

every ent_every ticks, only if something changed. spawn = [id,type,x,y,z,yaw,hp] (feet, Minecraft yaw; hp null for items); move = [id,x,y,z,yaw] after moving > 0.02 or turning > 2 deg; hp = [id,hp]; fuse = [id,0|1] (creeper swelling or ignited); item = [id,item,count] of item entities (on spawn and when the stack changes); remove = ids that died, were picked up, exploded, left the radius, the ent_max nearest or the level. After hello everything comes again as spawn
the creeper exploded: explosion (src creeper) and blocks with the clears came in the same tick, ent remove follows
